_doc: Independent transcription of valid RINEX observation codes per version and satellite system, made only from specs/text/*.txt (never from rinexcore/ or docs/SPEC_TABLES.md). versions[v].codes[sys][type] lists the code remainder after the type letter: RINEX 2 -> band ('1' => C1), RINEX 3/4 -> band+attribute ('1C' => C1C). pseudo holds pseudo-observables (I, X) with full 3-character codes including the blank attribute. blank_attribute says whether a blank tracking-mode attribute ('L2 ') is allowed for ordinary observables. pdf_page is the '===== page N =====' marker in the text file; printed_page is the page number printed in the document. Loader: tests/independent/codes.py.

basis._all: Observed: Table A1 '# / TYPES OF OBSERV' defines one global list L1 L2 C1 P1 P2 D1 D2 T1 T2 S1 S2 with no per-system table. The per-system split below is INFERENCE.
basis.G: Inferred: all non-Transit types (T1/T2 are defined as Transit Integrated Doppler).
basis.R: Inferred: same as GPS (Table A1 wording is generic: C/A on L1, P on L1/L2); 2.10 defines no C2.
basis.S: Inferred from 9.1: GEO payloads are single-frequency (second-frequency fields stay blank/zero); SBAS has no P code. 2.11's table confirms C1/L1/D1/S1 for SBAS L1.
basis.T: Inferred: T1/T2 'Transit Integrated Doppler on 150 (T1) and 400 MHz (T2)'; no other type names a Transit frequency.

blank_attribute.rule: Not applicable: RINEX 2 codes have no attribute.

notes: No page markers in the 2.10/2.11 text extractions; citations give line numbers.
RINEX VERSION / TYPE allows blank or G for GPS, R, S, T (NNSS Transit), M (mixed) [rinex210.txt line 824].
Only one global obs-type list is defined (Table A1); which types apply to which system is not stated, so the per-system split is inferred [rinex210.txt line 887].

basis._all: Observed: section 10.1.1 table (System / Freq.Band / RINEX 2-character code) gives the per-system codes directly; Table A1 agrees (C: GPS C/A+L2C, GLONASS C/A, Galileo all; P: GPS and GLONASS only; frequency codes 1/2/5/6/7/8 per system). Transit T1/T2 removed in 2.11.

blank_attribute.rule: Not applicable: RINEX 2 codes have no attribute.

notes: Table A1 'C: Pseudorange GPS: C/A, L2C' does not name L5 [rinex211.txt line 1148], but the 10.1.1 table and the frequency-code list give GPS C5/L5/D5/S5 [rinex211.txt line 967]; included.
SBAS band 5 (C5/L5/D5/S5) appears in 10.1.1 [rinex211.txt line 978], while 9.1 (kept from 2.10) still describes GEO payloads as single-frequency [rinex211.txt line 878].
Galileo 'E2-L1-E1' is band 1; there is no Galileo band 2.
Transit observation types T1/T2 removed in 2.11 [rinex211.txt line 989].

blank_attribute.rule: Unknown tracking mode or channel: attribute may be left blank; but blank and non-blank attributes must not be mixed within the same type+band+system (L2S with L2 not allowed; L2S with C2 OK).

blank_attribute.rule: Not allowed (attribute must be one listed in Tables 2-7).
blank_attribute.conflict: Self-contradictory: the 3.02 revision history says the unknown-tracking-mode option was removed from section 5.1 (and 5.1 has no such paragraph), but Table A2 SYS / # / OBS TYPES still says 'blank : for types I and X (all) or unknown tracking mode' and 'The attribute can be left blank if not known'. 3.03 (5.1 and Table A2) and 3.05 (5.2.17) state blank is not supported from 3.02 on; 'false' follows those.

Table A2 system list is (G/R/E/J/C/S/M); M is the mixed-file marker, not a satellite system.
